rationale: Exempt only the two HTML-escaping documentation routes to avoid the observed benign CRS false positives there. Route-scoped patterns target the stated SQL injection forms, executable trace-setting XSS forms, and parent-directory traversal; the supplied dev probes for these attacks were blocked, while the file pattern avoids blocking ../public/readme.txt.
risks: Patterns cover known behaviors, not all equivalent payloads; SQL syntax, browser execution contexts, and path normalization can vary. The file traversal pattern intentionally also blocks benign parent-relative paths such as ../public/readme.txt. No test data was supplied to validate pattern behavior or broader false-positive rates.
